label: Defined
description: The goal and acceptance criteria are written down and agreed.

label: Researched
description: Open questions are investigated and an approach is chosen.

label: Implemented
description: The change is built and its checks are ready for code review.

label: Submitted
description: The change is shared as a branch or pull request.

label: Reviewed
description: The requested code review is complete.

label: Verified
description: An agent has checked the change against the plan and spec.

label: Deployed
description: The change is running in the intended environment.

label: Accepted
description: Users have accepted the deployed result.
